summary: To carry in a small shared alleyway on Shabbos, we put a beam over its entrance. This mishnah teaches how high the beam may be and how wide the entrance may be.
stIntro: If an alleyway is enclosed on three sides with courtyards opening into it from three sides, and the fourth side opens into a public domain, it is prohibited by rabbinic law to carry objects in it on Shabbat. However, carrying in an alleyway under those circumstances is permitted if a cross beam is placed horizontally over the entrance to the alleyway. summary: The korah over the alleyway must be wide enough to hold a small brick. The mishnah tells us how big that brick is: one tefach wide is enough.

summary: Travelers camping in an open valley can make a fence around their camp out of their animals' gear, and then carry inside it on Shabbos, if the fence is tall enough and the gaps are not too big.

chunks.he: שַׁיָּרָא שֶׁחָנְתָה בְּבִקְעָה וְהִקִּיפוּהָ בִכְלֵי בְהֵמָה,
chunks.en: A group of travelers that camped in a valley and put their animals' gear around it,
chunks.st: If a caravan camped in a valley, i.e., an open space not enclosed by walls, and the travelers enclosed their camp with partitions made of the animals’ equipment,

words.note: A group of travelers with animals.

chunks.en: may carry inside it,
chunks.st: one may carry inside the enclosed area,

chunks.he: וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיְּהֵא גָדֵר גָּבוֹהַּ עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים,
chunks.en: as long as the fence is ten tefachim high,
chunks.st: provided that the resultant partition will be a fence ten handbreadths high,

chunks.he: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ פְרָצוֹת יְתֵרוֹת עַל הַבִּנְיָן.
chunks.en: and the gaps are not more than the built part.
chunks.st: and that there will not be breaches in the partition greater than the built segment.

chunks.en: Any gap of about ten amos
chunks.st: Any breach that is approximately ten cubits wide

chunks.en: is allowed, because it is like a doorway.
chunks.st: is permitted and does not invalidate the partition because it is considered like an entrance.

chunks.en: More than that is forbidden.
chunks.st: However, if one of the breaches is greater than ten cubits, it is prohibited to carry anywhere in the enclosed area.

summary: Travelers can also make a fence from three ropes, one above the other, as long as the spaces between them are small and the whole fence is ten tefachim high.
stIntro: If a caravan is camped in a field, and the travelers seek to construct partitions to render the area fit for one to carry within it on Shabbat,

chunks.en: so that the whole fence is ten tefachim tall.
chunks.st: so that the entire partition, consisting of three ropes and the empty spaces between them, will be ten handbreadths high.
